SAN ÁNGEL, MÉXICO THE WORLD OF THE LIVING

I · BEFORE THE ADVENTURE

Three friends.
One unfolding story.

In San Ángel, young Manolo, Joaquín, and María share a childhood of friendship and possibility. As they grow, their paths are shaped by love, courage, and the question of who they want to become.

ManoloTHE MUSICIAN AT HEARTMaríaTHE FREE SPIRITJoaquínTHE BRAVE FRIEND

The friends, reunited later in their journey.

II · THE CROSSING

Love leads him
beyond the living.

Believing María has died, Manolo follows a promise into the afterlife. His own death becomes the beginning of a journey through memory—and back toward hope.

✧ ─── ✦ ─── ✧

III · A WORLD THAT REMEMBERS

Gone from sight.
Never from the story.

Beyond the living, a city glows with color, music, and the presence of those still held in memory. Welcome to the Land of the Remembered.

IV · THE STORY IS WAITING

Some worlds
are found
between pages.

A book stirs in the golden light.
Its next chapter is yours to discover.

    A LITTLE WONDER

    BEHIND THE PAGES

    A world made
    to be remembered.

    This independent academic experience celebrates storytelling, memory, and the visual world of The Book of Life (2014). It combines a scroll-led prologue, seven illustrated chapters, and a cinematic ending.

    Make yourself at home

    Scroll through the opening, then turn the book with its corners, the arrows, your keyboard, or a swipe. Glowing details invite a closer look. Sound is optional; the complete story is available in text.
